### We Build It Better

Since 1970, we have been fixing what fails in the auto industry. Our success is fueled by our
commitment to build better parts supported by better service.

[ [ACPN Award]][191]

### Content Excellence Award

CARDONE® Industries has been recognized as an award recipient at the 2023 Knowledge Exchange
Conference.

[Click to Read More][192]

[[CARDONE Reman Sustainability]][193]

### Reman = Sustainability

Since day one, we have operated from a position of environmental responsibility, where we live out
the 3 tenets of sustainability: Reduce, Reuse & Recycle.

[Learn About CARDONE Sustainability][194]

### OVER 50 YEARS OF EXPERIENCE AS AN INDUSTRY LEADER IN
### AFTERMARKET PARTS, ENGINEERING & INNOVATION

In 1970, Michael Cardone, Sr. and Michael Cardone, Jr. opened Cardone Industries in a North
Philadelphia storefront. The business started as a remanufacturer of windshield wiper motors - an
endeavor most in the automotive industry called an impossible idea. Through hard work and
innovation, the CARDONE company grew to be a leading supplier of high-quality, affordable
replacement parts.

[SEE OUR STORY][195]

### We Build It Better

Since 1970, we have been fixing what fails in the auto industry. Our success is fueled by our
commitment to build better parts supported by better service.

[ [ACPN Award]][191]

### Content Excellence Award

CARDONE® Industries has been recognized as an award recipient at the 2023 Knowledge Exchange
Conference.

[Click to Read More][192]

[[CARDONE Reman Sustainability]][193]

### Reman = Sustainability

Since day one, we have operated from a position of environmental responsibility, where we live out
the 3 tenets of sustainability: Reduce, Reuse & Recycle.

[Learn About CARDONE Sustainability][194]

### OVER 50 YEARS OF EXPERIENCE AS AN INDUSTRY LEADER IN
### AFTERMARKET PARTS, ENGINEERING & INNOVATION

In 1970, Michael Cardone, Sr. and Michael Cardone, Jr. opened Cardone Industries in a North
Philadelphia storefront. The business started as a remanufacturer of windshield wiper motors - an
endeavor most in the automotive industry called an impossible idea. Through hard work and
innovation, the CARDONE company grew to be a leading supplier of high-quality, affordable
replacement parts.

[SEE OUR STORY][195]

# Delphi


## Everything in Motion

With a brand presence in more than 150 countries, Delphi provides OE specification end-to-end
solutions from components to sophisticated software solutions. With a wide ranging portfolio
including gasoline fuel systems, diesel fuel systems, maintenance solutions, engine management, and
vehicle electronics, backed by OE-level diagnostic and test equipment, training, and technical
information. 

[Delphi Logo Megamenu card]

## Original Equipment

With the benefit of more than 100 years of OE heritage, Delphi is a leading OE manufacturer in fuel
technology.

## RelaDyne Owns the Last Mile

With RelaDyne’s network of over 190+ direct distribution centers, and a fleet of over 2,300+
delivery vehicles, we “own the last mile.” This means we can be flexible and nimble from market to
market adding true continuity of delivery across 45+ states throughout the US. Most major brand
programs rely on 3rd party delivery systems using multiple distributors which can be complex and
bureaucratic. This is what makes DuraMAX and RelaDyne your most reliable partnership for commercial,
industrial and agricultural lubricants. [**Contact us**][117] today and see how our robust
distribution system can make an impact on your business today.

# MANN+HUMMEL for a cleaner world: Leadership in filtration since 1941

**Filtration is everywhere. **We filter the air we breathe and the water we drink. Filtration can be
found in our cars, refrigerators and even in our showers and coffee machines. Without filtration,
there is no baby food, no computers, no medicines. And certainly no clean, safe planet.

Can you imagine a world without filtration? A world where almost nothing is safe? Neither can we.

That's why we at MANN+HUMMEL work every day on filtration solutions for **cleaner mobility**,**
cleaner air**,** cleaner water **and** cleaner performance & industry**. As one of the world's
largest filter manufacturers, we want to understand how this world works - and make it a little
better every day. Our goal** **is to **protect people, nature, and machines**. By using filtration
to separate the useful from the harmful.

For more than 85 years, we have stood for leadership in filtration. As a family-owned filter company
with German roots, we operate globally at more than 80 locations. For our filtration solutions, we
use the combined know-how of our employees, a global research and development network, and the
opportunities offered by digitalization. The future is being decided now. That is why today we**
**provide **filtration solutions for tomorrow.**

## Separating the useful from the harmful

[

### Cleaner Mobility

The world is constantly changing. For MANN+HUMMEL, "green mobility" means sustainable mobility
thanks to fine and brake dust particulate filters, and other technological innovations for a range
of vehicles and machines, even for alternative drive systems. This is how we reliably protect the
environment, people, and machines from fine dust and other pollutants.

][120]
[ READ MORE ][121]
[
][122]
[

### Cleaner Air

In order to fight against the increasing air pollution worldwide, we offer cutting-edge filtration
solutions for indoor and outdoor areas. For example, our high-performance air filters provide
protection in industry, while air filters for HVAC systems or mobile indoor air purifiers offer
protection from fine dust, viruses, bacteria, and other pollutants in the air.

][123]
[ READ MORE ][124]
[
][125]

### Cleaner Water

For us, access to clean water is a human right. Our portfolio ranges from reverse osmosis to nano-,
ultra-, micro- and coarse filtration. Water filtration solutions with cartridge and membrane
technologies enable us to solve challenges such as water scarcity and water pollution - for pure
water, sustainable industrial- and wastewater treatment.

Motor and industrial filters from MANN+HUMMEL increase machine efficiency and performance. High
costs caused by incorrect machine maintenance and downtimes can be prevented - with intelligent
filter monitoring, we set standards in predictive maintenance. For industrial processes that run
smoothly.

# MANN+HUMMEL for a cleaner world: Leadership in filtration since 1941

**Filtration is everywhere. **We filter the air we breathe and the water we drink. Filtration can be
found in our cars, refrigerators and even in our showers and coffee machines. Without filtration,
there is no baby food, no computers, no medicines. And certainly no clean, safe planet.

Can you imagine a world without filtration? A world where almost nothing is safe? Neither can we.

That's why we at MANN+HUMMEL work every day on filtration solutions for **cleaner mobility**,**
cleaner air**,** cleaner water **and** cleaner performance & industry**. As one of the world's
largest filter manufacturers, we want to understand how this world works - and make it a little
better every day. Our goal** **is to **protect people, nature, and machines**. By using filtration
to separate the useful from the harmful.

For more than 85 years, we have stood for leadership in filtration. As a family-owned filter company
with German roots, we operate globally at more than 80 locations. For our filtration solutions, we
use the combined know-how of our employees, a global research and development network, and the
opportunities offered by digitalization. The future is being decided now. That is why today we**
**provide **filtration solutions for tomorrow.**

We build what vehicles cannot run without — clean air, powertrain, and ride performance systems
engineered to perform under real-world pressure.

The Tenneco Way drives how we deliver, aligning our teams around speed, discipline, and execution
that uphold uncompromising quality while managing complexity at scale.

room for compromise.

solutions that power the transportation industry, from light vehicles to commercial trucks and
off-highway vehicles.

Our cutting-edge technologies don’t simply meet the demand for fuel economy, emissions control, and
acoustic performance, they continuously redefine the standard.

We’re not waiting for the future of eco-friendly mobility, we’re building it.

and technologies.

We’re living up to our purpose of being the most trusted partner and best manufacturer in the
industry. 

[ Explore Powertrain ][40]

world’s leading OEMs.

Team Tenneco designs, engineers, and delivers solutions that set the bar for safety, comfort and
performance. In a market that demands more every day, we make sure our customers not only meet those
demands but crush them.

It’s all part of our purpose – to be the most trusted partner and the best manufacturer and
distributor to the transportation industry.  

[ Explore Performance Solutions ][41]

DRiV is powered by more than 30 of the world's most trusted and respected aftermarket brands.

We know that it takes bold moves to unlock the true potential of the automotive aftermarket and

###  

### YOUR MOST TRUSTED PARTNER AND THE WORLD'S BEST MANUFACTURER AND DISTRIBUTOR IN THE
### TRANSPORTATION INDUSTRY.

###  

####  

About Us

## The Tenneco Way

We build what vehicles cannot run without — clean air, powertrain, and ride performance systems
engineered to perform under real-world pressure.

The Tenneco Way drives how we deliver, aligning our teams around speed, discipline, and execution
that uphold uncompromising quality while managing complexity at scale.

From the precision of the Formula 1® grid to the demands of everyday mobility, performance leaves no
room for compromise.

Neither do we.

[ Explore more ][37]

Solutions

## fueling the future

[ View all solutions ][38]
 
1. Clean Air
2. Powertrain
3. Performance Solutions
4. DRiV

As global experts in emissions control systems, Team Tenneco designs, engineers, and manufactures
solutions that power the transportation industry, from light vehicles to commercial trucks and
off-highway vehicles.

Our cutting-edge technologies don’t simply meet the demand for fuel economy, emissions control, and
acoustic performance, they continuously redefine the standard.

We’re not waiting for the future of eco-friendly mobility, we’re building it. 

[ Explore Clean Air ][39]

Our Powertrain business is all about pushing limits and delivering game-changing engine components
and technologies.

Team Tenneco leverages diverse fuel options to help our global customers tackle the toughest
regulations and market demands, ensuring they hit peak performance every time.

We’re living up to our purpose of being the most trusted partner and best manufacturer in the
industry. 

[ Explore Powertrain ][40]

Our Performance Solutions group is comprised of powerhouse businesses, each partnering with the
world’s leading OEMs.

Team Tenneco designs, engineers, and delivers solutions that set the bar for safety, comfort and
performance. In a market that demands more every day, we make sure our customers not only meet those
demands but crush them.

It’s all part of our purpose – to be the most trusted partner and the best manufacturer and
distributor to the transportation industry.  

[ Explore Performance Solutions ][41]

DRiV is powered by more than 30 of the world's most trusted and respected aftermarket brands.

We know that it takes bold moves to unlock the true potential of the automotive aftermarket and
through our unwavering commitment to integrity, exceptional engineering, and elite manufacturing,
we're propelling our brands into the future to better serve our customers. 

[ Explore DRiV ][42]

About us

## Our Global Footprint

Sustainability

## Bold steps today. Lasting impact tomorrow.

Team Tenneco’s unwavering commitment to social responsibility and sustainability is absolute, no
matter the challenge. We continuously improve our environmental, health, and safety practices while
crafting premium products that power global mobility—today and for the future.

# Decarbonization

## starts with intelligent technology

[
How ZF drives lower CO2 emissions
][2]

## Welcome to ZF

ZF is a global technology company supplying advanced mobility products and systems for passenger
cars, commercial vehicles and industrial technology. Its comprehensive product range is primarily
aimed at vehicle manufacturers, mobility providers and start-up companies in the fields of
transportation and mobility. ZF electrifies a wide range of vehicle types. With its products, the
company contributes to reducing emissions, protecting the climate as well as enhancing safe
mobility.

** Click on (+) to learn more about our products and technologies**

Hotspot 1 Technology

## Technology

We want to actively shape the future of technology for mobility and industry. Our aim is to convert
today’s potential into tomorrow’s competitive advantages.

[
How we shape the future
][3]
Hotspot 2 Products

## Products

We supply mobility systems for passenger cars, commercial vehicles and industrial technology. ZF
offers comprehensive product and software solutions for established vehicle manufacturers and newly
emerging transport and mobility service providers.

[
Our product portfolio
][4]
Hotspot 3 Aftermarket

## Aftermarket

As one of the leading companies in the aftermarket industry, ZF bridges the gap between today's and
tomorrow's needs by delivering what workshops, distributors, and fleets require across the board.

[
Our aftermarket product portfolio
][5]

Alongside the automotive sector – passenger cars and commercial vehicles – ZF also serves market
segments such as construction and agricultural machinery, wind power, marine propulsion, rail drives
and test systems.

With some 153,000 employees worldwide, ZF reported sales of €38.8 billion in fiscal year 2025. The
company operates 162 production locations in 29 countries.

## Press Releases

Use our Press Center to find press releases as well as photos and videos from all areas and on all
topics within ZF Group.
[
ZF Press Center
][6]

## Stories and Highlights

Dive deeper into ZF Group and learn more about its global activities. Our stories provide new
insights.

### High-Tech From ZF for a Better Driving Experience

We develop technical solutions that can make journeys in a passenger car safer, more comfortable,
and more enjoyable. Through our innovations, we improve and simplify everyday mobility for millions
of people around the world. Discover here a wide range of passenger car products from various fields
that are transforming driving into a whole new experience.
[
Climb in and enjoy the ride!
][7]
[

### A Dynamic, Low-emission Path to the Future

As freight traffic on roads around the world continues to grow, the decarbonization of heavy-duty
trucks is becoming increasingly important. With the TraXon 2 Hybrid, ZF is developing a driveline
solution that reduces greenhouse gas emissions while meeting upcoming, more stringent emissions
standards.
Technology

### A Dynamic, Low-emission Path to the Future

As freight traffic on roads around the world continues to grow, the decarbonization of heavy-duty
trucks is becoming increasingly important. With the TraXon 2 Hybrid, ZF is developing a driveline
solution that reduces greenhouse gas emissions while meeting upcoming, more stringent emissions
standards.
][8]
[

## APRA - Automotive Parts Remanufacturers Association

# International non-profit association
# representing the interests of the automotive remanufacturing industry

[weConnect_DSC03642_Assembly.jpg]

#### WE CONNECT

APRA Europe brings together members and all players along the remanufacturing supply chain. We
organize networking events, we cooperate with relevant exhibitions and associations, we provide a
communication platform and connect experts worldwide.

[weSupport_DSC03908_Ballestrem.jpg]

#### WE SUPPORT

APRA Europe provides expert support to its members and at dedicated public events. We inform on e.g.
latest trends, technologies, complex legal aspects and give advice to remanufacturers. Access to our
network helps finding answers to individual questions.

[weDefend_DSC03651.jpg]

#### WE DEFEND

APRA Europe defends the interests of its members and the automotive remanufacturing industry. We
fight for a level playing field in the aftermarket, give explanations to the public and share our
positions with public bodies.

[More about our values ][43]

## WE ARE WORKING FOR

[start_remanufactureres_APRA_pic5.png]

### Remanufacturers

[start_coredealers_APRA_image.png]

### Core dealers

[start_wholesalers_AdobeStock_212556527.png]

### Wholesalers

[start_suppliers_AdobeStock_177389238.png]

### Suppliers

[start_researchers_AdobeStock_311413288.png]

### Researchers

Remanufacturers perform the ultimate form of circular economy since decades. By giving additional
life to used products at equivalent-to-new warranty and quality, remanufactures provide 
contemporary solutions to a demanding market. 

Cores are the lifeblood of remanufacturing and the essential resource for production. Core dealers
are an essential part of the remanufacturing supply chain and bring together demand and supply.

Wholesalers are the customers of remanufacturers and make sure that produced items are transferred
to the final users. Same applies vice versa because the reverse supply chain is crucial for
remanufacturing.

Suppliers to remanufacturers provide products, spare parts, (specialized) equipment and expertise to
make the remanufacturing production process actually happen. 

Universities and research institutes work at the spearhead of knowledge generation. Researchers
create forward looking approaches and solutions for remanufacturing, track technology shifts and
screen market developments.  

[start_CircularEconomy_604929602.jpg]

# Circular Economy

Automotive Remanufacturing is
the ultimate form of circular economy.

[Learn more ][44]

## POSITIVE IMPACTS of Remanufacturing

Remanufacturing is the most sustainable business model because it comes with a number of positive
impacts on all dimensions of sustainability.

Environment

Remanufacturing saves
millions of tons of CO2 equivalent emissions,
85% of raw materials,
55% of energy compared with new production.

Economy

Remanufactured parts offer best value for money with comparable quality and equivalent functions as
new parts.

Employment

Remanufacturing offers much more jobs than the respective new parts production as it is more
labor-intensive.

Safety

Remanufactured parts come with full warranty and product liability because they fulfill equivalent
functions as new parts.

[E_WEB_08.png]
[E_WEB_09.png]
[E_WEB_12.png]
[E_WEB_13.png]

### Find out more:
### [www.un.org/sustainabledevelopment/][45]

## We contribute to the UN Sustainable Development Goals

Remanufacturing is fully in line with the
United Nations Sustainability Development Goals, in particular with number 8, 9, 12 and 13.

[Learn more ][46]

## non-profit association

[Learn more ][47]

## Become a sponsor

## What is Remanufacturing?

Remanufacturing is the process of restoring used automotive parts to like-new condition through a
rigorous process of disassembly, cleaning, inspection, replacement of worn components, reassembly,
and testing.

Driving Automotive Remanufacturing Solutions on a Global Scale

﻿ATC is a market-leading Independent remanufacturer providing OES and Aftermarket solutions for ICE,
HEV and BEV powertrains and drivetrains for customers worldwide.

Commitment that Reaches Every Corner of the World
Our 21 locations across 4 continents supply remanufacturing solutions to automotive OEM and
Aftermarket customers globally.
Expertise that Makes a World of Difference
Our remanufacturing solutions enhance vehicle longevity, reduce costs and promote global
sustainability.

## About ATC

Our mission is to positively impact our customers, team members, shareholders and planet through
enthusiastic service and responsible stewardship.

To get there, we leverage cutting-edge technology, rigorous quality control, and a skilled workforce
to deliver remanufactured parts and components that meet or exceed original specifications.

[ More About Our Company ][79]

## Solutions We Deliver

Our comprehensive product and services portfolios are uniquely aligned with both the broader market
transition toward electrification and the long-term service requirements of traditional ICE
vehicles.

### Transmissions

### Engines

### Driveline

### Electrification

### Electronics/
### Mechatronics

### Engineering
### Services

[ Learn More About ATC Solutions ][80]

## What is Remanufacturing?

Remanufacturing is the process of restoring used automotive parts to like-new condition through a
rigorous process of disassembly, cleaning, inspection, replacement of worn components, reassembly,
and testing.

### BEFORE

[Used, dirty automobile transmission before ATC remanufactures it][Used, dirty automobile
transmission before ATC remanufactures it]

### AFTER

[Clean, like new automobile transmission after ATC remanufactures it.][Clean, like new automobile
transmission after ATC remanufactures it.]
[ What is Remanufacturing ][81]

## Looking for a Great Career?

Join us at ATC, where your career can grow and change as your skills and interests do. We offer a
wide variety employment opportunities in locations around the world.

Our dynamic and diverse team embodies the loyalty and commitment our customers have come to expect
over our 85-plus years of serving the automotive industry. Check out our ATC careers now.

[ Learn More About Careers at ATC ][82]

## OUR PROMISE

TIMELY AND TRANSPARENT

We are here to help you get back to work as quickly as possible with a remanufactured diesel engine
or reman diesel part. We know that every day your truck or piece of equipment is down is lost
revenue and we understand your situation.

### HEAVY DUTY DIESEL ENGINES

Capital Reman Exchange provides complete services for everything you need to service to overhaul
diesel and natural gas remanufactured diesel engines. We offer a full range of parts and components
to meet your needs and preferences. Whether you need remanufactured parts and accessories or reman
engine overhaul service, Capital Reman Exchange is [here to help][58]. We also [buy engine
cores][59].

[Find out more][60]
[Find out more][61]

### MANUFACTURERS

Capital Reman Exchange specializes in Medium and Heavy Duty Industrial Diesel Engines from all of
the major manufacturers including [Caterpillar^{©}][62], [Cummins^{©}][63], [Detroit
Diesel^{©}][64], [Mack^{©}][65], [John Deere^{©}][66]. [Learn more about remanufactured
engines][67], [remanufactured parts][68] as well as [OEM and aftermarket parts][69].

### HEAVY DUTY DIESEL PARTS

At Capital Reman Exchange we carry a large assortment of parts to meet your needs. Those include:
[Diesel Engine Parts][70], [OEM diesel engine parts][71], [Aftermarket Suppliers][72], [Cylinder
Heads][73], [Camshafts][74], [Connecting Rods][75], [Crankshafts][76], [Engine Blocks][77],
[Overhaul Kits][78], [Remanufactured Engines][79], and [Warranty Programs][80].

[PARTS STORE »][81]

[Find out more][82]
[Find out more][83]

### STATE OF THE ART MACHINE SHOP

Our dedicated [team of professionals][84] and state of the art machine shop and engine building
facilities allow Capital Reman Exchange the ability to remanufacture your parts or engine to meet or
exceed OEM standards on site in Denver, Colorado. We remanufacture parts that can be remanufactured
to OEM specifications for a fraction of the cost of new parts. [learn more][85].

### INDUSTRIAL DIESEL SERVICES

We offer a wide variety of services to get you back on the road for industrial diesels manufactured
by Caterpillar, Cummins, as well as most other major manufacturers. Performance Camshaft:
Followers/Lifters/Tappets,Connecting Rods Remanufacturing, Crankshaft Design / Broken Crankshaft
Component Failures, Cylinder Blocks, Cylinder Head Machining, General Machining, Custom Services.
[learn more][86].

CRP Industries is a solution-centric supplier of name-brand automotive replacement parts as well as
industrial products. We are committed to developing sustainable solutions to problems caused by
advanced technology, envisioning a world where people and machines can perform at their best for
years to come.

Our dedicated staff works tirelessly to be the service market partner of choice for decision makers
and end users in all the sectors we serve.

attitude where we treat each other like family. CRP offers a culture of learning and recognition

## Awards, Recognitions & Service Activities
* [2019 ReMaTec Award Winner Trophy]
  
  ### CRP Industries Earns Best Reman Business Innovation Award For AAE Steering Systems Brand At
  ### ReMaTec 2019
  
  CRP Industries was praised for its introduction of lean principles and semi-automation.

[Learn More][42]

[[CRP Automotive logo]][43]

CRP Automotive, a business unit of CRP Industries, is a leading name in high-quality automotive
replacement parts throughout North America. Our family of brands covers a wide range of product
categories — and an even more extensive range of vehicle applications. CRP Automotive creates
sustainable solutions to problems caused by advancing technology — keeping vehicles on the road
longer and stronger.

[Visit automotive site][44]

[[CRP Industrial logo]][45]

CRP Industrial, a business unit of CRP Industries, has been a leader in the North American hose
market for more than 40 years. We offer trusted brands such as Reinflex high-pressure thermoplastic
hose and armored thermoplastic cover food and beverage hose. Additionally, our Perske line of
high-speed, high-precision motors has serviced a wide range of industries including woodworking,
metal, and plastic fabrication for 50 years.

[Visit Industrial site][46]

[[CRP Reman Logo]][47]

CRP Reman provides turnkey remanufacturing solutions for OES and Tier 1 suppliers, with specialized
expertise in electromechanical components, R&D, and testing. CRP Reman supports reliable component
programs designed to meet today’s sustainability and service demands.

[Visit site][48]

[[CRP Mexico Logo]][49]

CRP de México SA de CV, part of CRP Industries Inc., is located in Puebla, Mexico.  The company has
been doing business in Mexico since 1993. CRP de México SA de CV specializes in the representation
and distribution of high quality automotive products focused on satisfying the needs of the national
automotive market.

[[CRP Automotive logo]][43]

CRP Automotive, a business unit of CRP Industries, is a leading name in high-quality automotive
replacement parts throughout North America. Our family of brands covers a wide range of product
categories — and an even more extensive range of vehicle applications. CRP Automotive creates
sustainable solutions to problems caused by advancing technology — keeping vehicles on the road
longer and stronger.

[Visit automotive site][44]

[[CRP Industrial logo]][45]

CRP Industrial, a business unit of CRP Industries, has been a leader in the North American hose
market for more than 40 years. We offer trusted brands such as Reinflex high-pressure thermoplastic
hose and armored thermoplastic cover food and beverage hose. Additionally, our Perske line of
high-speed, high-precision motors has serviced a wide range of industries including woodworking,
metal, and plastic fabrication for 50 years.

[Visit Industrial site][46]

[[CRP Reman Logo]][47]

expertise in electromechanical components, R&D, and testing. CRP Reman supports reliable component
programs designed to meet today’s sustainability and service demands.

and distribution of high quality automotive products focused on satisfying the needs of the national
automotive market.

Automotive Transmission Parts Supplier

ABOUT CRS

Hong Kong CRS International Trading Company Limited is a professional auto transmission parts
supplier who is specializing in transmission industry for more than 15 years. Our company has been
committed to providing high-quality transmission parts for customers around the world.

Our remanufacturing bases are located in Guangzhou and Chongqing, China. Our products have been
recognized by international transmission companies, OE manufacturers, and direct users. The main
products include AT, CVT and DSG/DCT transmissions, TCM/TCU, double clutches, clutch forks, valve
bodies, transmission mechatronics, repair kits, pulley sets, self-developed valve cores, and other
precision parts for remanufacturing and repair.

ABOUT CRS

Hong Kong CRS International Trading Company Limited is a professional auto transmission parts
supplier who is specializing in transmission industry for more than 15 years. Our company has been
committed to providing high-quality transmission parts for customers around the world.

Our remanufacturing bases are located in Guangzhou and Chongqing, China. Our products have been
recognized by international transmission companies, OE manufacturers, and direct users. The main
products include AT, CVT and DSG/DCT transmissions, TCM/TCU, double clutches, clutch forks, valve
bodies, transmission mechatronics, repair kits, pulley sets, self-developed valve cores, and other
precision parts for remanufacturing and repair.

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.
